proposals.evidence: CDIAL 43 akṣi includes Awankari akh, Maiyan āc̣hi/ãc̣hi and Western Pahari aċh eye. These survey velar and affricate forms match the regional eye family; phonetic x represents the spirant counterpart of kh. Exact survey form ətʃiː is retained.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4661 candra includes Gujarati cā̃d/cā̃do moon, Assamese sā̃d and Sindhi caṇḍru. The western survey s-initial and retroflex-cluster variants fit this documented moon family; regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form tʃəɳɖ is retained.
